postconditions.description: Revoke recipient access: in the open Permissions and Policy drawer, click Revoke on the recipient row, then confirm in the Revocation Warning modal.
Delete the uploaded test folder from My Files: close the drawer, find the folder row, open its context menu, and select Delete to leave the tenant clean.
